title: A Performance Review With My Manager
script: Manager: [warmly] Come in, Ratih. Please sit down. This is just our regular six-month review, so there's nothing to worry about.
Employee: [slightly nervous] Thank you. I always feel a bit anxious before these meetings, even when I know they're routine.
Manager: [reassuring] That's very common. Let's start with the good news, because honestly, there's quite a lot of it.
Employee: [hopeful] Okay, I'm ready to hear it.
Manager: [pleased] Your project completion rate improved by almost thirty percent since January, which is genuinely impressive.
Employee: [smiling] That's a relief to hear. I've been trying to organize my week more carefully since our last conversation.
Manager: [interested] It clearly worked. Clients have also mentioned that you respond faster than before, and they appreciate that a lot.
Employee: [pleased] I'm glad that's noticeable. I started answering emails first thing in the morning instead of leaving them until later.
Manager: [thoughtful] Now, there's one area where I think you could grow, if you're open to hearing it.
Employee: [attentive] Of course, please tell me. I'd rather know now than find out later.
Manager: [gently] During team meetings, you rarely share your opinion, even when I know you have good ideas.
Employee: [honestly] That's true. I sometimes worry my ideas aren't developed enough to share out loud.
Manager: [encouraging] Your ideas don't need to be perfect before you share them. Half-formed ideas often become the best ones through discussion.
Employee: [thoughtful] I never thought about it that way. I suppose I've always waited until I felt completely certain.
Manager: [warmly] Try speaking up even when you're only seventy percent sure. The team values your perspective more than you realize.
Employee: [determined] Okay, I'll practice that, starting with tomorrow's planning meeting, even if it feels uncomfortable at first.
Manager: [smiling] That's exactly the attitude I like to see. Overall, this has been a strong six months for you.
Employee: [grateful] Thank you for the honest feedback, and for noticing the effort I've been putting in lately.
Manager: [warmly] Keep it up, Ratih. I'm looking forward to seeing how much you grow before our next review.
